cleaner.label: Conan cache
cleaner.description: Recipes and binary packages in Conan's local cache. Does not touch profiles, settings or remotes.

option.label: Packages in the Conan cache
option.description: Removes recipes, sources and binaries of the packages from the local cache (p folder), along with its database.
option.warning: Packages built with `conan create` exist only here and cannot be re-downloaded. Those fetched from a remote are re-downloaded with `conan install`. Close Conan before cleaning.
